
{{alias}}( order, M, N, X, LDX, y, sy, w, sw, ws, sws, params )
    Trains a linear model via stochastic gradient descent.

    Indexing is relative to the first index. To introduce an offset, use typed
    array views.

    If `M` or `N` is equal to `0`, the function returns `w` unchanged.

    Parameters
    ----------
    order: string
        Row-major (C-style) or column-major (Fortran-style) order.

    M: integer
        Number of samples.

    N: integer
        Number of features.

    X: Float64Array
        Input matrix.

    LDX: integer
        Stride of the first dimension of `X` (a.k.a., leading dimension of the
        matrix `X`).

    y: Float64Array
        Target array.

    sy: integer
        Stride length for `y`.

    w: Float64Array
        Weight array.

    sw: integer
        Stride length for `w`.

    ws: Float64Array
        Workspace array.

    sws: integer
        Stride length for `ws`.

    params: Object
        Params object.

    Returns
    -------
    w: Float64Array
        Weight array.

    Examples
    --------
    // Standard usage:
    > var ord = 'row-major';
    > var M = 50;
    > var N = 5;
    > var lambda = 2.5;
    > var eta0 = 0.01;
    >
    > var y = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( M, 0.0, 30.0 );
    > var X = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( M*N, -5.0, 5.0 );
    > var w = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( N, -0.05, 0.05 );
    > var workspace = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( N );
    >
    > var params = {{alias:@stdlib/ml/base/sgd/params/float64}}({
    ... 'penaltyParams': new Float64Array( [ lambda, 0.0 ] ),
    ... 'learningRateParams': new Float64Array( [ eta0, 0.0 ] ),
    ... 'intercept': 0.0,
    ... 'maxIter': 500,
    ... 'penalty': 'l2',
    ... 'learningRate': 'constant',
    ... 'lossFunction': 'hinge',
    ... 'fitIntercept': true
    > });
    > {{alias}}( ord, M, N, X, N, y, 1, w, 1, workspace, 1, params );
    <Float64Array>[ ... ]

    // Advanced indexing:
    > var ord = 'row-major';
    > var M = 50;
    > var N = 5;
    > var lambda = 2.5;
    > var eta0 = 0.01;
    >
    > var y = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( M, 0.0, 30.0 );
    > var X = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( M*N, -5.0, 5.0 );
    > var w = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( N, -0.05, 0.05 );
    > var workspace = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( N );
    >
    > var params = {{alias:@stdlib/ml/base/sgd/params/float64}}({
    ... 'penaltyParams': new Float64Array( [ lambda, 0.0 ] ),
    ... 'learningRateParams': new Float64Array( [ eta0, 0.0 ] ),
    ... 'intercept': 0.0,
    ... 'maxIter': 500,
    ... 'penalty': 'l2',
    ... 'learningRate': 'constant',
    ... 'lossFunction': 'hinge',
    ... 'fitIntercept': true
    });
    > {{alias}}( M, N, X, N, y, -1, w, -1, workspace, -1, params );
    <Float64Array>[ ... ]

    // Using typed array views:
    > var ord = 'row-major';
    > var M = 50;
    > var N = 5;
    > var lambda = 2.5;
    > var eta0 = 0.01;
    >
    > var y0 = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( M, 0.0, 30.0 );
    > var X0 = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( M*N, -5.0, 5.0 );
    > var w0 = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( N, -0.05, 0.05 );
    > var workspace = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( N );
    >
    > var y1 = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( y0.buffer, y0.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT*1 );
    > var w1 = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( w0.buffer, w0.BYTES_PER_ELEMENT*1 );
    > var params = {{alias:@stdlib/ml/base/sgd/params/float64}}({
    ... 'penaltyParams': new Float64Array( [ lambda, 0.0 ] ),
    ... 'learningRateParams': new Float64Array( [ eta0, 0.0 ] ),
    ... 'intercept': 0.0,
    ... 'maxIter': 500,
    ... 'penalty': 'l2',
    ... 'learningRate': 'constant',
    ... 'lossFunction': 'hinge',
    ... 'fitIntercept': true
    });
    > {{alias}}( M, N, X, N, y1, -1, w1, -1, workspace, -1, params );
    <Float64Array>[ ... ]


{{alias}}.ndarray( M,N, X, sx1,sx2,ox, y, sy,oy, w, sw,ow, ws, sws,ows, params )
    Trains a linear model via stochastic gradient descent using alternative
    indexing semantics.

    While typed array views mandate a view offset based on the underlying
    buffer, the offset parameters support indexing semantics based on starting
    indices.

    Parameters
    ----------
    M: integer
        Number of samples.

    N: integer
        Number of features.

    X: Float64Array
        Input matrix.

    sx1: integer
        First stride length for `X`.

    sx2: integer
        Second stride length for `X`.

    ox: integer
        Starting index for `X`.

    y: Float64Array
        Target array.

    sy: integer
        Stride length for `y`.

    oy: integer
        Starting index for `y`.

    w: Float64Array
        Weight array.

    sw: integer
        Stride length for `w`.

    ow: integer
        Starting index for `w`.

    ws: Float64Array
        Workspace array.

    sws: integer
        Stride length for `ws`.

    ows: integer
        Starting index for `ws`.

    params: Object
        Params object.

    Returns
    -------
    w: Float64Array
        Weight array.

    Examples
    --------
    > var ord = 'row-major';
    > var M = 50;
    > var N = 5;
    > var lambda = 2.5;
    > var eta0 = 0.01;
    >
    > var y = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( M, 0.0, 30.0 );
    > var X = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( M*N, -5.0, 5.0 );
    > var w = {{alias:@stdlib/random/array/discrete-uniform}}( N, -0.05, 0.05 );
    > var workspace = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( N );
    >
    > var params = {{alias:@stdlib/ml/base/sgd/params/float64}}({
    ... 'penaltyParams': new Float64Array( [ lambda, 0.0 ] ),
    ... 'learningRateParams': new Float64Array( [ eta0, 0.0 ] ),
    ... 'intercept': 0.0,
    ... 'maxIter': 500,
    ... 'penalty': 'l2',
    ... 'learningRate': 'constant',
    ... 'lossFunction': 'hinge',
    ... 'fitIntercept': true
    > });
    > {{alias}}( M, N, X, N, 1, 0, y, 1, 0, w, 1, 0, workspace, 1, 0, params );
    <Float64Array>[ ... ]

    See Also
    --------
